verdict.rationale: Segment's Public API is explicitly versioned (73.3.0) and ships a downloadable OpenAPI spec. Its reference has a Versioning section covering 'Accessing versions' and 'Backwards-incompatible or breaking changes', which points to a documented change policy. The evidence shows only these section headings, though, not the actual deprecation terms. missing for 10: explicit deprecation timelines/sunset notice periods, policy detail beyond section headings, versioning coverage for other APIs (Tracking, Profile), independent corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Segment Public API (73.3.0) — Download OpenAPI specification
